/* getGrpAuthrtSeCd - Yoo ChiHoon */
SELECT CASE WHEN GET_GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD >= 1 AND GET_GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD <= 5 THEN CONCAT(TO_CHAR(GET_GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD), '40') ELSE CONCAT(TO_CHAR(GET_GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD), '00') END AS GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD FROM ( SELECT INST_NO , INST_NM , CASE WHEN INST_NM = '여성가족부' THEN 1 WHEN INST_NM = '한국청소년상담복지개발원' THEN 2 WHEN (INST_NM LIKE '%'||'경찰서' OR INST_NM LIKE '%'||'경찰청') THEN 4 WHEN (INST_NM LIKE '%'||'교육부' OR INST_NM LIKE '%'||'교육청') THEN 5 WHEN (INST_NM <> '여성가족부') OR (INST_NM <> '한국청소년상담복지개발원') OR (INST_NM NOT LIKE '%'||'경찰서' OR INST_NM NOT LIKE '%'||'경찰청') OR (INST_NM NOT LIKE '%'||'교육부' OR INST_NM NOT LIKE '%'||'교육청') THEN 3 ELSE 9 END AS GET_GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD FROM SAA000 WHERE 1 = 1 AND INST_NO = #{INST_NO} )

/* getAuthrtSeCd - Yoo ChiHoon */
SELECT CASE WHEN #{GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD} = '340' THEN CASE WHEN #{PRVUSE_JOIN_SCRIN_YN} = 'N' THEN ( SELECT AUTHRT_SE_CD AS AUTHRT_SE_CD /* */ FROM ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_ID , CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS AUTHRT_SE_CD , UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE , CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 FROM SAC100 WHERE 1 = 1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'AUTHRT_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE LIKE (#{GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD} || REGEXP_REPLACE(#{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}, 'U', '') || '00') ) ) ELSE #{GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD} || '0000' /* 전용가입(지자체)*/ END ELSE #{GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD} || '0000' /* 전용가입*/ END AS AUTHRT_SE_CD FROM DUAL

/* selectAuthrtSeCd - Yoo ChiHoon */
SELECT CMMNS_CD_ID , CMMNS_CD_VALUE , UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE , CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 FROM SAC100 WHERE 1 = 1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'AUTHRT_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE LIKE (#{GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD} || REGEXP_REPLACE(#{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}, 'U', '') || '%')
